skill.description: Generate full songs and instrumental tracks with ElevenLabs Music through the RunComfy CLI. Use style descriptions, lyrics, section markers, duration, instrumental mode, and output format to create 5-second to 5-minute audio.

security_audit.summary: All 59 static matches are false positives involving Markdown syntax, reference links, scoped token storage, or music guidance. One semantic finding concerns blanket shell-safety assurances that overlook shell parsing before CLI invocation. No evidence found of malicious intent or prompt injection; external CLI behavior was not independently verified.

remediation.issue: The shell-safety assurance in SKILL.md:176 ignores shell parsing before JSON reaches the CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the blanket assurance. Serialize JSON and pass it as a literal argument without shell interpolation, or document correct shell escaping for arbitrary lyrics.

semantic_findings.title: Blanket Shell-Safety Assurance Omits Caller Quoting
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md claims "No shell-injection surface from prompt content" while demonstrating shell commands with single-quoted JSON. Inserting unescaped lyrics containing apostrophes can break shell quoting before the CLI parses JSON, potentially allowing command execution.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Shell parsing precedes CLI JSON handling, so the blanket assurance does not protect interpolated shell commands. Exploitation depends on unsafe insertion; the fixed examples themselves contain no payload.

content.value_statement: Creating structured songs or instrumental tracks can require separate tools and manual setup. This skill sends focused prompts to ElevenLabs Music through RunComfy and downloads the audio.
actual_capabilities: Generate vocal songs with style briefs, lyrics, and section markers.
Create instrumental beds for podcasts, games, videos, and study content.
Set output duration from 5 seconds to 5 minutes per request.
Control instrumental mode and select supported MP3 or WAV output formats.
Download generated 44.1 kHz stereo audio through the RunComfy CLI.
limitations: Each request accepts one prompt containing both style guidance and lyrics.
A single request cannot exceed 5 minutes of generated audio.
Longer pieces require external stitching and may increase cost.
The endpoint does not provide voice identity selection or singer cloning.

use_cases.title: Podcast Production
use_cases.description: Create short instrumental intros, outros, and transition beds with clean endings and controlled duration.

use_cases.title: Video And Game Soundtracks
use_cases.description: Generate mood-matched background tracks or loop-friendly instrumental music for videos and game scenes.

use_cases.title: Brand Music
use_cases.description: Draft jingles, stingers, theme music, and multilingual campaign songs from a clear creative brief.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Instrumental
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second upbeat instrumental for a product demo. Use warm piano, light drums, and a clean ending. No vocals.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short background track

prompt_templates.title: Study Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second lo-fi instrumental for a study video. Use 75 BPM, Rhodes piano, soft drums, low variation, and a loop-friendly ending. No vocals.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with tempo and arrangement constraints

prompt_templates.title: Structured Vocal Song
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-second indie-pop song at 120 BPM with bright guitars, driving drums, and a warm female lead. Use [Intro], [Verse], [Chorus], and [Outro] sections. Write concise lyrics about starting over.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with song structure, style, and original lyrics

prompt_templates.title: Multilingual Campaign Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 45-second uplifting brand song with acoustic guitar, hand percussion, and a memorable chorus. Use [Verse] in English and [Chorus] in Brazilian Portuguese. Keep the meter consistent and end with a clear musical resolve.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a multilingual branded asset

output_examples.input: A 20-second calm instrumental intro for a technology podcast, with soft synths and a clean ending.
output_examples.output: A stereo instrumental audio track with a calm electronic texture, suitable for a podcast opening.

output_examples.input: A 60-second indie-pop song with verse and chorus sections about a morning commute.
output_examples.output: A structured vocal song with an intro, verses, chorus, and a polished stereo mix.

output_examples.input: A 5-second cheerful brand stinger using marimba and one uplifting chord, without vocals.
output_examples.output: A short instrumental stinger with a bright marimba accent and a resolved final chord.

best_practices: State the genre, mood, tempo, instruments, vocal type, and mix priorities clearly.
Use section markers and consistent lyrical meter for vocal songs.
Draft at a short duration before paying for a longer final render.
anti_patterns: Do not combine contradictory styles in one prompt.
Do not use this music endpoint for standalone sound effects.
Do not submit lyrics without confirming the right to use them.

faq.question: What can this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates vocal songs, instrumental tracks, jingles, podcast beds, theme music, and game background loops.

faq.question: How long can one track be?
faq.answer: Each request supports 5 seconds to 5 minutes of audio.

faq.question: Can it generate instrumental music?
faq.answer: Yes. Set instrumental mode and state that the prompt should contain no vocals.

faq.question: Can I provide lyrics?
faq.answer: Yes. Include original or properly licensed lyrics with section markers in the single prompt.

faq.question: Which formats are supported?
faq.answer: Standard MP3 is the documented default. WAV is also listed; check the model page for currently supported format values.

faq.question: What does this skill need to run?
faq.answer: It needs the RunComfy CLI, valid RunComfy authentication, network access, and an output directory.
